name: Wikipedia Category:Data centers / operator pages
notes: Tested categorymembers API successfully. No dedicated complete US data-center list found; category is global and mixes concepts, companies, and facilities. Useful as a low-volume seed/de-dupe source, especially pages such as Google data centers and Colossus, but not a primary expansion feed.

name: Utility Dive news, RSS, search, and Data Centers and the US Grid trendline
pagination: RSS latest feed plus semantic search query pages; trendline is static article collection
notes: Tested RSS, article HTML, search, and trendline. Feed is free and directly parseable; search pages are verbose but contain article cards and links. Good for early signals on utility-backed loads, power plants, tariffs, and named projects; not a clean project table, so extraction needs NLP and de-dupe against primary announcements.

name: Data Center Dynamics news archive
pagination: site archive/search pages, but blocked for bare curl by Cloudflare challenge
notes: Tested direct curl to news page and RSS path; both returned Cloudflare challenge/403. Search index snippets expose project-level articles and capacities, so it is valuable for manual/web-search assisted discovery but fragile for unattended crawling without an allowed browser session or licensed feed.

name: Virginia Economic Development Partnership press releases
pagination: Drupal press-release listing and query parameters; individual pages are static HTML
notes: Tested list and individual pages. Strong source for Virginia announcements, investment amount, county, jobs, status, incentive eligibility, and sometimes capacity/square footage. Search/filter semantics need discovery, but page URLs are stable and easy to parse.

name: State economic development press-release portals as a repeatable class
pagination: varies by state CMS: Drupal, WordPress, Sitefinity; usually query/page parameters and RSS/sitemaps
notes: Cross-state tests on VA, IN, and WI show state EDO pages are consistently free and authoritative for early announcements. Recommended to build a configurable state portal crawler for top data-center states, seeded by search terms data center/datacenter/cloud/AI infrastructure and then customized per CMS.
